title: Split the main menu by submenu

  - kind: refactor
  - area: cli

`MainMenu.cs` is 485 lines holding the evolve, compile and shrink, evolve-parts, redo, run and benchmark menus, and `ConsoleUi` and `EvolutionSession` are close to 300.
We want one file per submenu, each calling the run services, and the session code left in the application layer.

Its responsibilities are:
* `EvolveMenu`, `CompileMenu`, `PartsMenu`, `RedoMenu`, `RunMenu`, `BenchmarkMenu`
* `ConsoleUi` split if it holds more than one surface

Menu text and order should not change, because the README describes them.

Where: `SNP_Evolution/Cli/MainMenu.cs`, `ConsoleUi.cs`, `MenuPrompts.cs`.

Done when:
- [ ] Every file in `Cli/` is under 300 lines with one job
- [ ] `dotnet test` green

Read first: README "Using the GUI"
